text: Critics and participants have framed the Esports World Cup as a Saudi sportswashing project: GeoGuessr map creators blacked out their maps in protest, calling the tournament 'a sportswashing tool used by the government of Saudi Arabia to distract from and conceal its horrific human rights record', and GamesBeat reports the event is 'frequently framed' this way.

source.name: Engadget
source.note: GeoGuessr AB later withdrew from EWC 2025; GamesBeat (2026-05-14) carries the same sportswashing framing.
